entries.title: Isaiah 13:1
segments: ¶The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:2
segments: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:3
segments: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, [even] them that rejoice in my highness.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:4
segments: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle. {like...: Heb. the likeness of}

entries.title: Isaiah 13:5
segments: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, [even] the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:6
segments: ¶Howl ye; for the day of the LORD [is] at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:7
segments: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt: {be faint: or, fall down}

entries.title: Isaiah 13:8
segments: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces [shall be as] flames. {be amazed: Heb. wonder} {one...: Heb. every man at his neighbour} {flames: Heb. faces of the flames}

words.text: of them; they shall be in pain
. {be amazed: Heb. wonder} {one...: Heb. every man at his neighbour} {flames: Heb. faces of the flames}

entries.title: Isaiah 13:9
segments: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:10
segments: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:11
segments: And I will punish the world for [their] evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

words.text: ; and I will cause the arrogancy

entries.title: Isaiah 13:12
segments: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:13
segments: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:14
segments: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

words.text: And it shall be as the chased

entries.title: Isaiah 13:15
segments: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined [unto them] shall fall by the sword.

words.text: ; and every one that is joined

entries.title: Isaiah 13:16
segments: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

words.text: also shall be dashed to pieces

entries.title: Isaiah 13:17
segments: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and [as for] gold, they shall not delight in it.

words.text: against them, which shall not regard

entries.title: Isaiah 13:18
segments: [Their] bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

words.text: ; and they shall have no pity

entries.title: Isaiah 13:19
segments: ¶And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. {as...: Heb. as the overthrowing}

entries.title: Isaiah 13:20
segments: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

entries.title: Isaiah 13:21
segments: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there. {wild...: Heb. Ziim} {doleful...: Heb. Ochim} {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

words.text: But wild beasts of the desert
there. {wild...: Heb. Ziim} {doleful...: Heb. Ochim} {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

entries.title: Isaiah 13:22
segments: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in [their] pleasant palaces: and her time [is] near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged. {the wild...: Heb. Iim} {desolate...: or, palaces}

words.text: And the wild beasts of the islands
